tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | cons b bs =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => exact ih bs i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)

induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => simp only [List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ]; exact ih bs i _
